pages.text: Tier 4 Mekanism unlocks the apex tech content: MekaSuit, MekaTool, QIO Network, Fusion Reactor, and Antimatter production.

$(bold)MekaSuit:$(/bold) The best armor in the pack for tech-path players. Modular, upgradeable, and powerful. Requires extensive Mekanism infrastructure to produce.$(br2)$(bold)MekaTool:$(/bold) All-in-one tool replacing pick, axe, shovel, hoe, and sword. Configurable modes. Endgame default tool.

$(bold)Fusion Reactor:$(/bold) Produces enormous amounts of RF. Building one is a T4 capstone project. Powers the late-game Mekanism factory comfortably.$(br2)$(bold)Antimatter:$(/bold) Produced via Particle Accelerator. Required for several Mythic infusion recipes and the Oblivion's Rift portal components.

$(bold)No book needed.$(/bold) Mekanism Generators and Tools are documented alongside the core mod at $(bold)mekanismmod.com$(/bold). Focus on the Fission Reactor and Fusion Reactor at T4 — both require significant infrastructure.
